note: JobLease.tla activation-latch (finding #1257): Activate(j1,w1) at now=0 (deadline 1000); Expire(j1) at now=1000 reclaims the past-deadline lock (JobLockExpired resets the job to activatable but LEAVES Job::activated set); Complete(j1) STILL succeeds without re-activation, because CompleteJob gates on the persistent `activated` latch, not a live or recorded lock. This is the engine-valid trace the model must admit: an expired lease costs at most a redelivery, never a lost job.
